Reflexological stimulation of each foot reflex area activated the superior part of the contralateral SI hemisphere.

The analysis was based on the hypothesis that the hemodynamic responses were induced by the stimulation of the eye reflex area on the right foot with correct information [R(correct)] and pseudo [R(pseudo)] and the stimulation of the eye reflex area on the left foot with correct information [L(correct)] and with pseudo-information [L(pseudo)].
Reflexological stimulation of each foot reflex area activated the superior part of the contralateral SI hemisphere.
The cortical areas significantly activated in each subtraction analysis are shown in Table 2.
